claims.evidence: No import documents, shipping labels, or VIN/engine code visible in any photo.
No video or audio of the engine running; no test-bench photo provided.
Requires audio/video of running engine; photos are static.
No odometer, service book, or mileage sticker shown.
No close-up of bolt seals, gasket surfaces, or factory markings to confirm it hasn't been disassembled.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually run or could be seized/damaged internally
risks.proof: Video clip of cold start and idle, or compression test readout

risks.risk: Missing critical components (ECU, wiring harness, sensors, turbo)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of full wiring harness, ECU unit, and sensor connectors

risks.risk: Unknown donor vehicle make/model/engine code, affecting compatibility and value
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine ID/code plate or casting number
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic engine, lowest matching tier

risks.risk: Transmission may not be included or may not match the engine
risks.proof: Seller confirmation plus photo showing engine and transmission bolted as a unit with matching part numbers
risks.if_unproven: priced as engine only, transmission excluded

risks.risk: Strut assemblies condition/compatibility unknown (could be unrelated parts bundled for listing)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of strut brand tags, rust, and mounting points
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used struts, no premium

risks.risk: Possible flood or salvage damage not visible in current framing
risks.proof: Photos of block corrosion, water staining, or rust lines inside intake
risks.if_unproven: priced as potential salvage/flood risk, worst case

risks.risk: Wet ground staging may hide leaks or fresh cleaning to mask defects
risks.proof: Photo of engine on dry surface showing any fluid stains underneath

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and idling with sound audible
Close-up photo of engine ID/code plate or casting number
Photos of wiring harness, ECU, and sensor connectors
Confirmation and photo showing transmission bolted to engine as sold unit
Close-up photos of strut tags, mounting condition, and rust
Photo of engine on dry ground to check for fluid leaks
response.reason: The witness identified the item as a generic used engine-transmission-strut parts lot, so it can be priced at worst case despite all seller claims being unverifiable from the photos alone.
